sources.title: TowerPro MG90S product page
sources.ref: https://towerpro.com.tw/product/mg90s-3/ mass 0.0134 kg; prose envelope 0.0228 x 0.0122 x 0.0285 m (table C is 0.0284 m and table D is 0.0124 m; width is the dimension line, the same 0.0122 m the gauge pocket uses); stall torque 0.1765 N·m at 4.8 V and 0.2157 N·m at 6.6 V; no-load 10.472 rad/s at 4.8 V and 13.090 rad/s at 6.0 V; dead band 1e-6 s. The operating-voltage sentence names only 4.8 V. Seller listings often print a 4.8-6 V range and put 0.2157 N·m at 6 V; this part follows the manufacturer page.

sources.title: Assumed stall current, until M2
sources.ref: 0.70 A at 5 V, measured on a generic MG90S by ProtoSupplies (https://protosupplies.com/product/servo-motor-micro-mg90s/). The TowerPro page has no stall current. R = 7.14 ohm is 5/0.70. Quiescent 0.01 A is that listing's idle figure. Assumed; the owner M2 reading replaces the stall current.

sources.title: Assumed pulse window
sources.ref: 5.44e-4 to 2.4e-3 s, the Servo.h window this runtime maps. The TowerPro page states no pulse range. ProtoSupplies describes 1e-3 to 2e-3 s. Assumed.

sources.title: Assumed saturation, logic and joint, until M5 and M6
sources.ref: Copied from the SG90 fit: eSat 0.3 rad, signal frequency 40-200 Hz, logic vil 0.9 V and vih 2 V, signal abs-max -0.3 to 6 V, joint armature 5e-5 kg·m2, frictionloss 0.002 N·m, damping 0.0025 N·m·s/rad. Metal gears are not the SG90 nylon train; no published difference. Assumed.

sources.title: Class-1 fit at 4.8 V
sources.ref: K = 0.458 V·s/rad from the 4.8 V no-load speed, rounded like the SG90. efficiency 0.573 from the 4.8 V stall torque. Class 0 slew is that 4.8 V speed, 10.472 rad/s. A DC motor scales speed and torque with V. At 6.0 V the speed matches the page; torque scales above the 0.2157 N·m the page assigns to 6.6 V. Shaft torque rating 0.215 N·m is that 6.6 V figure, truncated to 0.001 N·m.

sources.title: Case box
sources.ref: Visual and inertia use the prose envelope. The gauge pocket plan is examples/gauge/cad/lib/dimensions.py at 0.0228 m by 0.0122 m. Inertia is the solid box of that envelope at 0.0134 kg, about the center.

sources.title: No behaviour class 2
sources.ref: The control IC, motor and potentiometer composite is later. This part has no class 2.
